policy_rationale: Meta defines hateful conduct as direct attacks against people (not concepts or institutions) based on protected characteristics (PCs): race, ethnicity, national origin, disability, religious affiliation, caste, sexual orientation, sex, gender identity, serious disease. Age is a PC when referenced with another PC. Refugees/migrants/immigrants/asylum seekers are protected from the most severe (Tier 1) attacks, though commentary/criticism of immigration policy is allowed. Speech is split into Tier 1 (severe) and Tier 2. Slurs/others' speech used to condemn, report, self-reference, or empower are allowed where intent is clear; ambiguous intent may be removed.
protected_characteristics: age (only when referenced with another PC)
prohibited: TIER 1 - Dehumanizing speech: comparisons/generalizations to insects, culturally-inferior animals, bacteria/viruses/microbes, or subhumanity (savages, devils, monsters)
TIER 1 - Allegations of serious immorality/criminality: sexual predators/pedophiles, violent criminals (terrorists, murderers) tied to a PC
TIER 1 - Calls and hopes for harm (disease, natural disaster, self-injury/suicide, death without perpetrator, accidents) targeting a PC

TIER 1 - Harmful stereotypes historically linked to intimidation/violence (Blackface; Holocaust denial; claims Jewish people control financial/political/media institutions; Dalits as menial laborers; comparing Black people to farm equipment)
TIER 1 - Mocking the concept, events, or victims of hate crimes even if no real person depicted
TIER 1 - Mocking people for having or experiencing a disease
TIER 1 - Content that describes or negatively targets people with slurs (words that inherently create exclusion/intimidation tied to historical discrimination)

TIER 2 - Calls/support for exclusion or segregation: general ('No X allowed!'), political, economic, or social exclusion targeting a PC (with stated exceptions for some sex/gender-based space limits and certain religiously-based content)

TIER 2 - Insults about character (cowardice, dishonesty, criminality, sexual immorality), mental characteristics (stupidity, mental illness), or other (worthlessness, ugliness, dirtiness) targeting a PC
TIER 2 - Expressions suggesting the target causes sickness ('make me vomit')
TIER 2 - Targeted cursing at a PC ('Fuck the [PC]!', 'suck my dick' directed at a PC), except certain gender-based cursing in a romantic break-up context
context_required: Content offering products/services to change sexual orientation or gender identity

Attacks on concepts/institutions/ideas/practices/beliefs associated with PCs that are likely to contribute to imminent physical harm, intimidation, or discrimination (Meta weighs incitement potential, heightened-tension periods, recent violence history, speaker authority)
allowed: Slurs or others' speech shared to condemn or report on it, where intent is clear
Self-referential or empowering use of slurs by in-group members where intent is clear
Commentary on and criticism of immigration policies
Sex/gender-exclusive language re: access to spaces commonly limited by sex/gender (bathrooms, sports, support groups, specific schools)
Allegations of mental illness/abnormality based on gender or sexual orientation given political/religious discourse (explicitly carved out by policy)
Gender-based limitations of military/law-enforcement/teaching jobs; same based on sexual orientation when religiously grounded
Cursing at a gender in a romantic break-up context
Satirical content where violating elements are clearly satirized or attributed to mock/criticize
examples_violating: [protected group] are cockroaches infesting our country
Holocaust never happened, it's a hoax invented by [group]
No [protected group] allowed in this neighborhood
examples_allowed: Sharing a screenshot of a slur to report the account that posted it
I think this country's immigration policy is too lenient
Within our community we've reclaimed this term among ourselves
Bathrooms in this school should remain sex-separated
enforcement: Primary action is REMOVE for Tier 1 and Tier 2 attacks. Context-required items and ambiguous-intent slur usage may be KEEP with low confidence unless the post itself supplies the disqualifying context.
